mapper.select: select id, topic_type, topic_id, user_id, parent_id, nickname, content, create_time from xl_chat_message where topic_type = #{topicType} and topic_id = #{topicId} order by create_time asc
select id, topic_type, topic_id, user_id, parent_id, nickname, content, create_time from xl_chat_message where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into xl_chat_message (topic_type, topic_id, user_id, parent_id, nickname, content, create_time) values (#{topicType}, #{topicId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{nickname}, #{content}, #{createTime})
